args.body: Advance LIVE-TENDER-AMENDMENT-BRIEF-TRIAL using the committed source inventory and receipts. Reconcile the interrupted and redacted results before spending either official retrieval. If capacity remains, prioritize the official release history for the saved Retail Data Management, Analytics and Automation baseline (OCID ocds-h6vhtk-07b6cb, release 105838-2026), unless a committed candidate already has stronger revision evidence. The January 8 deadline is historical until confirmed. On a fit, execute the comparison and identical-input control, save the actual results, and give bidders a bilingual checklist showing exactly what to update, with revision IDs, excerpts and source hashes. Stage only if the existing placement remains suitable and obtain the exact dry-run digest for host-enforced independent review. If the allowance is exhausted without two comparable revisions and a currently open window, save the specific gap and reopening evidence. Read back artifacts and close under a valid lease with a lesson.
